posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
The stand alone version must be authenticated with a key.
The way it has been set up is that that key will not only authenticate the stand alone version, but can also be used to add it to your Steam account.
It's basically a free steam copy, because the key should still work to authenticate the software even after it's been used to add the software to the steam library. It would probably be bad for business if the key could only be used once, since typically people upgrade their computer every 5 - 7 years.
